Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2 Must be the first field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following BodyLength field up to and including the de- limiter preceding the CheckSum (10) field. Must be the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequential sequence number for the session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates a message resent from the admin level (has a duplicate sequence number). Defaults to N.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender. Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (TargetCompID (56) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: GMT date and time that message was sent. Nanosecond level resolution.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination. CEDX for messages sent to CEDX ports. (SenderCompID (49) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of destination. TEST for messages sent to the Cboe test system. PROD for messages sent to the Cboe production system. (SenderSubID (50) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Possible resend flag. Cboe has special handling for the PossResend for New Order Single messages. See New Order — Single below.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on messages to Cboe. Must be identifier known to Cboe. May be used by non-service bureau to specify which clearing arrangement to use if multiple are configured.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: End-client sub identifier. Four characters, alphanumeric, otherwise not validated. Recorded and re- turned in DeliverToSubID (129). Available via Drop.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For messages with PossDupFlag (43) = Y, indicates time that message was first sent. Nanosecond level resolution.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on message from Cboe. Must be Cboe approved identifier.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Returns OnBehalfOfSubID (116) optionally sent by client.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Modulo 256 checksum of all characters in the message up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum field. Three digits with leading zeroes if necessary.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time cancel initiated/released. Required by FIX 4.2 but not used by Cboe. Nanosecond level resolution.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Product Code for Symbol Filter

Field.Name: MassCancelInst
Field.Description: At least one character must be provided (Trading Firm Filter). Contiguous characters must be specified up to total length. Truncated (unspecified) characters will default to values indicated below. 1st Character : Trading firm Filter A = No filtering by trading firm is performed. F = All orders (both options and futures) that were sent under the trading firm specified in OnBehalfOfCompId (115) will be cancelled. U = All futures orders that were sent under the trading firm specified in OnBehalfOfCompId (115) will be cancelled. O = All options orders that were sent under the trading firm specified in OnBehalfOfCompId (115) will be cancelled. J = All orders with an equity leg that were sent under the trading firm specified in OnBehalfOfCompId (115) will be cancelled. If “F” , “U” , “O” or “J” is specified and OnBehalfOfCompId (115) is not provided, the Purge Request will be rejected. If “U” , “O” or “J” is specified, it cannot be combined with a Product Code or CustomGroupId filter, i.e. Symbol (55) and CustomGroupId (7699) must not be set. 2nd Character : Acknowledgement Style M = (Default) Individual Execution Reports are sent for each cancelled order. S = Single Purge Acknowledgement sent once all cancels have been pro- cessed. Single Purge Acknowledgement will contain MassCancelId (7695) and CancelledOrderCount (7696). MassCancelId (7695) must be specified or the Purge Request will be rejected. B = Both individual Execution Reports and single Purge Acknowledgement. Also requires MassCancelId (7695) to be specified or the Purge Re- quest will be rejected. 3rd Character : Lockout Instruction N = (Default) No lockout L = Lockout until corresponding Risk Reset received. Lockout can be used only with trading firm Filter set to ”F”, ”U”, ”O” or ”J”, otherwise the Purge Request will be rejected. If trading firm filter is set to ”F”, Lockout will apply to all new orders and cancel/replace orders for the trading firm (and Symbol (55) or CustomGroupId (7699), if specified). If trading firm filter is set to ”U”, ”O” or ”J”, Lockout will apply to all new future orders, options orders or orders with an equity leg (respec- tively), and cancel/replace orders for the trading firm. Symbol (55) or CustomGroupId (7699) should not be specified in these cases. 4th Character : Instrument Type Filter B = (Default) Cancel both Simple and Complex orders S = Cancel Simple orders only C = Cancel Complex orders only If Symbol (55) is specified, it must contain a valid underlying symbol, in which case only orders underlying on that symbol will be cancelled. A self-imposed lockout can be released using the RiskReset (7692) field of the New Order Single message. If Symbol (55) is not specified and zero CustomGroupId (7699) are specified, a Clearing Firm level reset is required. If Symbol (55) is specified, a Symbol level reset is required. If one or more CustomGroupId (7699) values are provided, a CustomGroupID level reset is required.

Field.Name: MassCancelID
Field.Description: This field will be echoed back in the resulting Purge Acknowledgement when the second character of MassCancelInst (7700) is set to ”S” or ”B”. Purge Request containing a MassCancelID that is currently outstanding will be rejected.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: 3 = Status

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: M = Mass Cancel Complete

Field.Name: MassCancelID
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming Purge Request.

Field.Name: CancelledOrderCount
Field.Description: Number of orders cancelled from a Purge Request with the specified Mass- CancelID

Field.Name: OrdStatus
